comments.author: Barlog_M
comments.body_html:
1. Mod ignores this raid setting. Scavs only be normal and hard. Marksmans always hard.

2. MaxGroupSize is a maximal group size that selected randomly from 1 to MaxGroupSize. For example on Factory Day can be from 4 to 5 PMC bots and they can spawns like [3, 2] or [1, 1, 2], or [2, 2] or [1, 1, 1, 1, 1] etc.

Same for scavs except group size in wave set like 0 to selectedByMod and then game decides what amount of scavs to spawn.

comments.author: silada
comments.body_html:
You made a terrible design choice by bundling several mods with different scopes inside a mod that has very limited competition. It looks like you are trying to do a married sale, and push other features that even have mods that do the same and better, so in the end we get a lot of conflicts. You should always narrow down the scope of your mods, and instead of nesting 50 mods inside one, release 50 different mods, it improves user experience.

I liked when your mod was simpler, even if it didn’t work properly, at least its scope was narrow, so you could troubleshoot properly. This is not personal, just feedback. I came back to try your mod once again now that my game is more stable, and I’ve found that I’ll not be using it for the reasons above.
